phases.title: Recovery and authoritative inventory
phases.deliverables: Capture spec provenance; generate exact module/screen registers; audit repository availability; establish evidence ledger; clarify unresolved inputs without stopping safe work.

phases.title: Engineering workspace and contract foundation
phases.deliverables: Monorepo boundaries; pinned toolchain; ADRs; OpenAPI/event schema conventions; database migrations; dev containers; CI lint/tests; per-hospital cell model.

phases.title: Cross-platform design system and navigation
phases.deliverables: Tokens; components; three web shells; staff/patient mobile shells; route ownership; menu eligibility; status states; EN/FR; visual snapshots at 320–1920px.

phases.title: Security, tenancy and authorization foundation
phases.deliverables: OIDC/MFA; facility/role/shift context; RBAC/ABAC; patient-scope authorization; consent policy engine foundation; tenant isolation tests; audit capture and command deduplication.

phases.title: Facility and workforce operations foundation
phases.deliverables: Facility/configuration lifecycle; staff roles and privileges; hospital-cell provisioning and routing; capability-based sidebar and mobile More sections.

phases.title: Registration, identity and consent
phases.deliverables: Patient search/registration/provisional identity; identity merge review; consent/disclosure lifecycle; patient-context guard.

phases.title: Scheduling and emergency intake
phases.deliverables: Appointments, resource scheduling, triage prioritization and queues, staff mobile triage/vitals entry as permitted by authoritative APIs.

phases.title: Clinical chart and ADT
phases.deliverables: Encounters, admission/transfer/discharge, beds, notes, diagnoses, observations, vitals, signing/amendment and mobile bedside views.

phases.title: Medication safety and nursing
phases.deliverables: Allergy state; prescribing; medication safety revision; medication administration; nursing plans and handovers, barcode workflows with real service acknowledgement.

phases.title: Laboratory and imaging
phases.deliverables: Laboratory specimen lifecycle, results and critical acknowledgement; imaging orders/reports/PACS references; offline boundaries.

phases.title: Pharmacy and transfusion
phases.deliverables: Pharmacy stock, reservations, release and dispensing; blood bank chain of custody and bedside cross-checks.

phases.title: Surgery and care transitions
phases.deliverables: Theatre/anesthesia/recovery, checklists, referrals/transfers and receiving owner acknowledgement.

phases.title: Specialty clinical packages
phases.deliverables: Eight specialty packages; scoped protocol, forms, authorizations, validation and clinical review for each.

phases.title: Patient mobile and proxy portal
phases.deliverables: Patient/proxy enrollment, appointments, record access, notifications, documents, consent and Android/iOS secure session controls.

phases.title: Billing, cashier and claims
phases.deliverables: XAF currency accuracy, charge master, immutable invoices/ledger, cash/payments, insurer approvals/claims and reconciliation.

phases.title: Procurement, stores, assets and HR
phases.deliverables: Purchase-to-pay, stock, biomedical maintenance, rosters/HR/payroll, permission segregation and HIS integration.

phases.title: Facility services and hospital intelligence
phases.deliverables: Ambulance/transport, dietary orders, mortuary chain-of-custody, operational BI and fresh provenance-backed dashboards.

phases.title: Terminology, documents and evidence
phases.deliverables: Clinically governed terminology/formulary/rules, forms/signatures, immutable audit/provenance and retention.

phases.title: Interoperability, devices, offline and SRE
phases.deliverables: Versioned FHIR/HL7 integrations; device gateways; notifications; locally authoritative sync and conflicts; backup/restore, telemetry, downtime playbooks.

phases.title: Whole-platform testing and scoped release
phases.deliverables: End-to-end web/mobile/API integration; representative load; hazard review; security tests; failure drills; disaster recovery; EN/FR/accessibility/visual and supervised hospital pilot certification.
